 Jenna Dewan Reveals the Fun Halloween Tradition Her Family Does Every Year (Exclusive)
 Erin Clack, Yamillah Hurtado 2026년 10월 31일 토 오후 5:30 UTC 0 Jenna Dewan, Steve Kazee and kidsCredit: Jenna Dewan/Instagram NEED TO KNOW
 Jenna Dewan revealed to PEOPLE that she and her family have a fun Halloween tradition they do every year
 The actress shares son Callum, 6, and daughter Rhiannon, 2, with partner Steve Kazee, as well as daughter Everly, 13, with ex-husband Channing Tatum
 Dewan is currently competing in season 35 of Dancing with the Stars 
 Jenna Dewan and her family go all out for spooky season.
 The actress, 45, revealed to PEOPLE that she, her kids and her fiancé, Steve Kazee , have a fun Halloween tradition they do every year.
 “We go to HomeGoods, and we let the kids fill up their basket with whatever they want to decorate the house with,” she shared at the premiere of week 7 of season 35 of Dancing with the Stars .
 “Because if you ask Evie, her favorite thing about holidays is decorating the house,” she continued, referring to her daughter Everly , 13, whom she shares with ex-husband Channing Tatum . “It’s like a real thing. So this year we went and we decorated the inside and the outside completely. We are more Halloween than we’ve ever been this year.”
 She added, “Yeah, shout-out to HomeGoods!”
 Jenna Dewan, Steve Kazee and kids do a ‘Jurassic World’-themed group costume for HalloweenCredit: Cibelle Levi | @cibellelevi In addition to Everly, Dewan shares son Callum, 6, and daughter Rhiannon, 2, with Kazee, 51.
 Back in 2023, Kazee shared a glimpse of the family’s home decked out for Halloween on TikTok .
 In the clip, a caption explained that the over-the-top decorations were in honor of a party for a “little girl,” seemingly Everly, who was celebrating her 10th birthday at the time.
 “My favorite little girl asked me to throw her a Halloween party this year, and I might have outdone myself,” Kazee wrote, as the camera took viewers on a short tour around the home.
 Advertisement
 Jenna Dewan, Steve Kazee and kids Callum and Everly on Halloween in 2022Credit: Jenna Dewan/instagram The decorations included purple and orange twinkle lights in the bushes outside, thick cobwebs hanging from the ceiling, walls and light fixtures, and a large skeleton seated at a piano. A long table in the foyer was covered with treat bags for the party guests.
 Speaking with PEOPLE in 2024, Dewan joked that Everly always chooses a Halloween costume idea that’s trickier to pull off.
 “She doesn’t pick a costume that I can just go buy at a store,” the Step Up star explained. “She’s like, ‘I want to be the anime character from this TV show’ that no one else has ever watched, that there’s zero costumes on the internet for.”

 “I’m on Etsy three months ahead of time trying to find bits and pieces that all come together to be this one anime character,” she continued. “But that’s been fun, but it’s every year, so I’m used to it with her.”
 Steve Kazee and Jenna Dewan with daughter Rhiannon; Callum and RhiannonCredit: Jenna Dewan/Instagram (2) Last year, Dewan shared photos on Instagram of her family’s whimsical Halloween costumes .
 Callum wore a green frog costume, while his little sister, Rhiannon, dressed as cotton candy in a pink and purple ruffled tulle ensemble. Dewan went as a fly — complete with big glasses and an antenna headband — to pair with Callum’s frog, and Kazee sported the same piñata costume he wore in 2022.
 Dewan captioned the post, “We committed.”
